name: Zimperium v2
summary: Threat page. Spring page fields match app_version_list.json.
notes: The public Zimperium console docs were not loaded. GET /threats/public/v1/threats uses the Spring page in app_version_list.json: content, totalElements, totalPages, last.
This mock returns content and pages with page and size. totalElements is the catalog size only when the page is built; the generator writes the page, not the page metadata object.
Login at /auth/v1/api_keys/login is not modeled. A bearer token is required.
attribution: Checked against a public vendor reference or, when that page is blocked, the integration test fixture plus the public client. See /presets/ATTRIBUTION.md.
